about: Blind judgement of before vs cur and before vs var: the same game at the same demo tick, side by side without labels. See README.md.

judge.how: claude -p --safe-mode --tools Read, one call per pair, sheet.png alone in a fresh empty mkdtemp dir as cwd; unparseable answer re-asked once
judge.question:
First open sheet.png in the current directory with the Read tool. It shows two screenshots side by side, LEFT and RIGHT, of the first frame of a small 3D mobile game made from the request: "<sentence>". Page text is hidden, so judge only the 3D scenes. Which first frame looks like a finished game from an app store – polished art, lighting and materials and readable characters, rather than an unfinished prototype? End your reply with exactly one line in this form and nothing after it:
VERDICT: LEFT – <one short reason>
or
VERDICT: RIGHT – <one short reason>

order.prng: pure-rand xoroshiro128plus + uniformInt(0, 1) per pair in sentence order, profile after profile; 0 = before is LEFT

pairs.sentence: racing a shark through a coral reef
pairs.reason: richer colour and contrast make the reef and racers easier to read than in the washed-out right frame.

pairs.sentence: stack pizzas as high as the moon
pairs.reason: the pizza stack is clearer and better framed, though both look like prototypes

pairs.sentence: a chef flips pancakes for a line of hungry customers
pairs.reason: slightly richer lighting and depth with a more readable pancake stack, though both still look like prototypes.

pairs.sentence: A squirrel jumps over logs in a forest
pairs.reason: slightly richer lighting with soft cliff shadows and more ambient life, though both are near-identical

pairs.sentence: A fish swims through a coral reef
pairs.reason: marginally more readable character details, though both look like unfinished prototypes

pairs.sentence: like flappy bird but in a jungle
pairs.reason: more consistent atmospheric lighting and shaded pipes that fit the jungle scene, though both still look like prototypes

pairs.sentence: A ranger shoots zombies in a forest
pairs.reason: the ranger has a slightly crisper outline and stronger shading, so the character reads a bit better.

pairs.sentence: Two knights duel in a castle
pairs.reason: the outlined knights are easier to read, though both frames still look like prototypes

pairs.sentence: racing a shark through a coral reef
pairs.reason: more vibrant coral colours and contrast make the reef look richer and easier to read

pairs.sentence: stack pizzas as high as the moon
pairs.reason: slightly tighter framing and a highlight make it a bit more polished, though both look like prototypes

pairs.sentence: a chef flips pancakes for a line of hungry customers
pairs.reason: richer lighting contrast, depth and particle effects make it look more polished than the flat, washed-out left frame

pairs.sentence: A squirrel jumps over logs in a forest
pairs.reason: slightly richer foliage, shadowing and depth make it look a bit more polished

pairs.sentence: A fish swims through a coral reef
like flappy bird but in a jungle
A ranger shoots zombies in a forest
Two knights duel in a castle
